hold_poses.warm_smile: rest pose with a slightly warmer closed-mouth smile; the hold of A04, A06, A08, A10 and the start and end of A17
hold_poses.seated: seated, eyes open and soft, small smile
hold_poses.warm_smile_glow_35: warm smile with a steady inner glow at 35% of peak (dark render may keep a faint outer halo; light render none)
hold_poses.pose_before_tap: whatever pose was showing before the tap

animations.name: rest_pose
animations.beats: Standing straight on, eyes open, warm closed-mouth smile, arms relaxed, feet slightly apart.

runtime.note: also A02 poster and Settings still

animations.name: idle_breathe
animations.beats: Breathe in 0-2.4 s (rise 2%, widen 1% near base, leaves sway 6-8 deg), out 2.4-4.8 s; one slow blink 3.2-3.55 s; last frame equals first; file loop count 2.

animations.name: welcome_wave
animations.beats: Right arm (viewer's left) lifts clear of the shoulder line 0.2-0.6 s; one slow ~20 deg sway 0.6-1.3 s; lowers 1.3-1.6 s; settle.

animations.name: wird_done_shimmer
animations.beats: One move: light band sweeps up feet to tip 0.2-1.0 s while the smile warms; one slow blink at 1.1 s. Smallest animation in the set.

animations.name: milestone_glow
animations.beats: Inner light rises base to tip 0.3-1.6 s (peak over >=0.4 s); dark render halo outside silhouette, light render none; no motes (S only); one slow blink at 1.6 s; face, blush and feet unchanged.

animations.name: earned_back_steady
animations.beats: One move: body swells 3% and settles in two wobbles while leaves lift and settle 0.2-1.2 s; one slow blink at 1.3 s. Also used for a made-up day.

animations.name: hard_session_compassion
animations.beats: Right arm to the chest 0-0.5 s; one slow blink (closed 0.4 s) 0.5-1.4 s with the smile kept; arm lowers 1.4-2.0 s. Brows never move; body never pitches forward.

animations.name: rest_sit
animations.beats: Lowers and sits, feet slide forward 0-1.0 s; soft squash settles in two wobbles 1.0-1.6 s; one slow blink 1.4-2.2 s. No raised arms, no yawn.

animations.name: juz_light
animations.beats: Inner light fills base to tip 0.3-1.8 s (peak over >=0.6 s); dark render halo, light render none; 5-7 round motes rise straight up from the tip and fade 1.0-3.0 s; one slow blink at 1.6 s; feet on the ground. Ceiling for every achievement.

animations.name: tap_hello
animations.beats: Review export only. Starts and ends on warm_smile. One blink and the smile warms a little 0-0.3 s, leaves sway 8 deg and settle 0.1-0.7 s. No squash, no haptic.

animations.name: onboarding_hello
animations.beats: Review export only. Fade in 18% above rest with eyes closed 0-0.2 s; drop into place 0-0.45 s; landing squash 0.45-0.55 s; one wobble 0.55-0.75 s, eyes open at 0.5 s; A04 wave compressed into 0.75-2.35 s; settle 2.35-2.6 s.

cut.A03: arrive: no surface; bounce for its own sake
cut.A05: intention_settle: resembles the standing posture of salah
cut.A12: sabaq_glad: same as A06 without the hop
cut.A13: made_up_settle: indistinguishable at 64 pt; use A08
cut.A18: empty_waiting: a waiting pose is an ask

budget_bytes.counts: every runtime export incl. variants, posters and the A01 still; masters and review exports excluded; decimal bytes

sampling: nominal samples = round(seconds x 24); first and last samples exactly on start and hold poses; integer ms frame durations summing to the declared length; identical samples may merge
